verdict.rationale: Background automation is a fair question for an agentic-commerce platform, but the evidence documents no product-provided way to set up recurring or autonomous background automations. Machine payments, MPP/x402 and the MCP server are developer building blocks for agents someone else builds and runs. The Link CLI requires customer approval for each spend request, and MCP write actions need human confirmation. The catalog feed cadence is a seller-side upload recommendation, not a scheduler the product provides.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
